meta.source: 50 user-supplied head photos p001-p050 (small web-size images, 158-590 px high)
meta.method: Per photo, hand-placed rectangular patches (colorsample-style median of sRGB 8-bit, no gamma/white-balance correction) verified on overlays; per-region value = median over photos whose lighting class is N (near-neutral) or W (mild warm) after excluding photo-specific bad patches; range = [median of per-photo dark-quartile, median of per-photo light-quartile] (typical dark..light inside the patch incl. shading and specular, not extremes).
meta.colour_space: sRGB 0-255 as in JPEG, display-referred; white balance NOT corrected.
warnings: Photos are heavily compressed web images with uncontrolled white balance; absolute values are +-10-15 per channel.
Warm (W) photos carry a mild warm bias; N photos are near neutral. Cast photos are listed under excluded.
Pooled medians mix life stages; use stage_medians for dorsal_head/snout/cheek/opercle/lower_jaw/lip_plate.

dorsal_head.lighting_notes: Sampled on the dark dorsal cap (top of skull/snout, nape side). Photos 010-027 (from above) and side views. Neutral (N) set: daylight/overcast/aquarium-strobe; warm (W) set: slight yellow/brown water or net bounce (+5..10 on R, -5..10 on B); excluded: green fern cast p002, teal p004, green-dappled p005, golden-green p012, blue p014/p016/p019/p032/p038/p039, orange p031/p041/p044, yellow-green p024/p036, HDR p026. Adults are far darker (74,60,40) than parr (121,108,86); the pooled median hides a bimodal distribution - use stage medians.

cheek.lighting_notes: Cheek = skin between eye and preopercle. Ranges from cream-white silver (parr/smolt in sun, 227,210,194) to olive-bronze (adult, 158,126,78) to rose/lilac (spawning-colour, 140,126,126). Pooled median is a mid pinkish tan; lilac/blue gloss from sky reflection is a specular effect, not base colour (p007, p011 excluded).

opercle.lighting_notes: Gill-cover plate. Base is a translucent pearly plate: silver-cream in parr/smolts, olive-bronze to copper in adults (p022/p023/p034/p050), with lilac/pink/blue-green iridescent sheen changing with view angle. Strong sky-blue patches on p011/p016 are reflections and are not in the median except p011 base bronze.

opercle_rim.lighting_notes: Posterior margin of the opercle (thin curved band). Warm: gold/amber/copper (p023 169,150,103; p028 207,184,124; p050 168,126,80; p034 166,123,96) or salmon-pink (p018, p046) in several parr/smolts, pale cream in p013/p021/p022. Only 10 photos have a clean, resolvable rim; the band is 3-8 px wide in these photos.

preopercle_line.lighting_notes: Thin groove/ridge at the preopercle edge. Polarity differs: in most photos (p007,p010,p015,p017,p023) the lit edge is a pale cream line (value = light-quartile of a thin patch) while in p021 it is an amber-brown line (173,141,120). The line is 1-3 px wide so values are lit-edge estimates, low confidence.

lower_jaw_side.lighting_notes: Side of the lower jaw below the mouth line. Silver-grey to lilac-grey (parr 154,145,142; adult 134,126,129) with peach/cream in p030/p013/p028 and blue-lilac in p010/p025/p029; mint bounce in p040 is a cast and was excluded from the underside regions only.

lower_jaw_underside_throat.lighting_notes: Ventral skin of lower jaw/throat. Strongly lighting dependent: shadowed (p006 87,45,50; p011 48,40,40; p021 87,96,104) vs lit peach/cream (p030 194,167,156; p034 165,151,115). Only 5 usable photos; bimodal; the single pooled median is NOT a good descriptor - use lit_median for a lit ventral surface. Confidence low.

upper_lip_maxilla_plate.lighting_notes: Pale strap along the upper lip (maxilla). Pale cream-white in sunlit parr (p013 221,209,186; p008 191,186,187; p010 198,183,182; p021 199,188,199), bronze-brown in adult/shaded (p006 137,116,104; p022 116,97,83). A thin dark-brown groove line runs along its upper edge (see extra_observations).

lip_edge.lighting_notes: Dark gape line / lip margin. Value is the DARK quartile of a patch straddling the gape (the line itself is 2-5 px wide); dark navy/violet in 5 photos (p006,p021,p022,p029,p050), brown-purple in p013,p034,p040 because the patch included lip tissue. Inner lower-lip surface is pale blue-lilac (range upper bound).

mouth_lining_inside.lighting_notes: Only open-mouth photos (p007,p008,p015,p017,p021,p022,p023,p035 used; p038,p039,p042 excluded for blue/teal cast; p040 green bounce). Bimodal: cavity in shadow is near black-navy; lit tissue is pink-mauve to violet-grey. Pooled median (61,60,72) is a dark slate; use dark_cavity_median for the throat/pharynx and lit_tissue_median for the palate/tongue edges. Photo p015 has a small bright pink-magenta spot (206,164,182) on the palate.

iris_ring.lighting_notes: Thin gold/bronze ring immediately around the pupil: value = median of warm (R-B>25) pixels in an annulus 1.1-1.7 pupil radii, then the light range is the brightest 20% of those. Variation is low-resolution partial-volume mixing with the dark iris. Wide dark brown/olive iris band beyond the ring is not included (see eye_outer_dark_rim and markdown).

pupil.lighting_notes: Near-black, slightly blue-black (5,6,8). Specular catchlights make light end (25,22,32) in range, true white catchlights excluded. Value is the dark quartile of the pupil patch.

eye_outer_dark_rim.lighting_notes: Dark pigmented skin/orbital rim immediately outside the gold ring and the dark smear in front of and behind the eye. Dark brown to maroon (p003 44,31,26; p027 42,38,43; p050 68,40,43), olive-grey in pale photos (p008,p033 94,94,85). Only 6 usable photos.

nostril_pit.lighting_notes: Anterior nostril pit on the snout (dark pit with pale/bluish or pinkish rim in p021, p035, p050). Value is the dark quartile (pit centre). p040 shows a whitish bump instead (breeding tubercle-like), light end of range.

gill_membrane_branchiostegal.lighting_notes: Branchiostegal membrane under the opercle/throat. Visible with fine radiating ribs in p011 (shadow), p013, p017, p022, p023, p028, p034. Silver-grey to pale blue-lilac in p017/p022/p023, cream-yellow in p028/p034, dark in p011 (shadow). Only 7 photos and the area is small/oblique - low confidence.

upper_lip_groove_line.description: thin dark-brown line (groove between snout skin and the pale maxilla strap) running from the nostril region back under the eye

dark_postorbital_smear.description: diffuse dark maroon-brown patch behind the eye on the upper cheek, 0.5-0.9 eye diameters wide

dorsal_to_ventral_head_transition_fracti.axis: 0 = dorsal outline of head, 1 = ventral outline
